updateMessage: Movie Portal v3.5.209 update is ready! Permanent Android playback parity release (WebView surface fix, multi-stage SW/SurfaceView/FFmpeg codec recovery, and zero-stall streaming).
releaseNotes: Eliminates black-screen WebView overlay occlusion, synchronizes Media3 surface lifecycle across episode/fallback transitions, adds full runtime audio/video codec capability detection, and implements 4-level playback recovery.
